name: gooner-client
description: Gooner Client — open-source Minecraft launcher for macOS (OneClient parity minus World Hosting)
author: Gooner Client Contributors

scripts.dist:mac: npm run build && electron-builder --mac dmg --arm64 --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:mac:arm64: npm run build && electron-builder --mac dmg --arm64 --publish never
scripts.dist:mac:x64: npm run build && electron-builder --mac dmg --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:linux: npm run build && electron-builder --linux AppImage --x64 --publish never
